_description: Curated use cases pointing at recommended models and builds. Editorial, but every id resolves into models.json or builds.json.

useCases.label: Casual chat / writing
useCases.desc: General-purpose assistant. 8 B–14 B is plenty.

useCases.label: Coding assistant
useCases.desc: Local copilot. Qwen 3.6-27B dense (May 2026) is the new single-24 GB-card king at 77 % SWE-Bench Verified; 35 B-A3B MoE if you want speed; 70-106 B for hard multi-file work.

useCases.label: Agents / tool use
useCases.desc: Tool-calling, multi-step workflows. Honest answer: sub-200B local models still cap around 55-59 % Terminal-Bench 2.0. Need 200B+ MoE — MiniMax M2.7 and Hy3-preview are the new on-the-cusp options.

useCases.label: Long-context RAG
useCases.desc: Big documents, 100 K+ context. Needs spare VRAM for KV cache. Qwen 3.6-27B / 35B-A3B / Mistral Medium 3.5 all natively 256-262 K.

useCases.label: Vision / multimodal
useCases.desc: Image understanding, OCR, screen agents. Qwen 3.6-27B dense adds vision to the small-model tier; Mistral Medium 3.5 brings it to 128 B.

useCases.label: Frontier / power user
useCases.desc: Run 120 B–1.6 T open weights. Big rigs only.

useCases.label: Image generation
useCases.desc: Local Stable Diffusion / FLUX / Qwen-Image / HiDream-O1. Sec/image is the metric.

useCases.label: Video generation
useCases.desc: Local WAN / Hunyuan / LTX text-to-video + img-to-video. HunyuanVideo 1.5 now runs in 14 GB with offload — new consumer sweet spot.
